name: watcher
title_zh: 每个文件改动都留快照的版本管家
tagline_zh: 改崩了想回滚？它早把每一步都拍了照。不用记命令，不用开 Git，文件变动自动留痕，随时翻旧账。
tagline_en: Roll back any change without Git commands. It snapshots every file edit automatically, so you can always rewind.
desc_en: Watch every file fleet touches — snapshot and diff fleet state,
why_zh: 不是事后追悔，而是事前布防。每个文件变动都生成独立快照，diff 清晰可见，状态恢复像翻相册一样直观。
why_en: Proactive, not reactive. Every edit gets its own snapshot with clear diffs, making rollback as easy as flipping through photos.
limit_zh: 只监控 fleet 工具显式触碰过的文件，不监听全盘写入；快照存本地，不推远端；不处理二进制大文件。
limit_en: Only watches files fleet explicitly touches, not whole-disk writes. Snapshots stay local, no remote push. Skips binaries over 10MB.
title_en: Snapshot every file change with a version steward
